CMAP = {2: 8, 3: 4, 4: 3}

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(map(int,row)) for row in grid]; a=np.array(g)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(a==2)
    comps={i:np.where(lab==i) for i in range(1,n+1)}
    for i,(ys,xs) in comps.items():
        r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if h>=3 and w>=3 and len(ys)==2*(h+w)-4:  # rectangular frame
            dots=[(int(y2[0]),int(x2[0])) for j,(y2,x2) in comps.items()
                  if j!=i and len(y2)==1 and r0<y2[0]<r1 and c0<x2[0]<c1]
            if len(dots)==1:
                r,c=dots[0]
                dist=min(r-r0,r1-r,c-c0,c1-c)
                col=CMAP.get(dist,8)
                for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for cc in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if g[rr][cc]==0: g[rr][cc]=col
    return g
